raw.query: WITH c AS (SELECT r.run_id, r.experiment, r.window_name, r.policy, r.lead_s, r.pool, r.denominator_kind, r.numerator_worker_seconds, r.cost_ratio FROM provenance.v_dim AS d JOIN provenance.v_cost_ratio AS r ON r.run_id = d.run_id WHERE d.is_current = TRUE AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND r.is_current = TRUE AND r.denominator_kind = 'deployable_static_c8' AND r.run_id IN ('a2:burst3_forecast_L30','a2:burst3_reactive_L30','a2:steady24h_forecast_L165','a2:steady24h_reactive_L165')) SELECT f.window_name, f.lead_s, f.run_id AS forecast_run, q.run_id AS reactive_run, f.numerator_worker_seconds AS forecast_worker_seconds, q.numerator_worker_seconds AS reactive_worker_seconds, f.cost_ratio / q.cost_ratio AS forecast_to_reactive_ratio, (f.cost_ratio / q.cost_ratio - 1) * 100 AS forecast_premium_pct FROM c AS f JOIN c AS q ON q.experiment = f.experiment AND q.window_name = f.window_name AND q.lead_s = f.lead_s AND q.pool = f.pool AND q.denominator_kind = f.denominator_kind WHERE f.policy = 'forecast' AND q.policy = 'reactive' ORDER BY f.window_name
raw.claimed: burst3 +13.7%; calm day at L=165 s +13.9%
raw.evidence: Current, non-superseded v_cost_ratio rows round to +13.7% for burst3 and +13.9% for steady24h (the calm day).
